streamSettings.chromeEchoNote: Chrome can exclude Balacopapo audio when the capture type supports it

streamSettings.electronMacAudioNote: macOS 13+ requires Screen & System Audio Recording permission

systemAudioNote.excluded: Viewers hear your computer's sound, but not the voice chat or other Balacopapo audio.
systemAudioNote.excludedMac: Viewers hear your Mac's sound, but not the voice chat or other Balacopapo audio. macOS asks for Screen & System Audio Recording permission.
systemAudioNote.includedWindows: This Windows version shares all sound, the voice chat included: viewers will hear their own voices. On Windows 11, Balacopapo's own audio is left out.
systemAudioNote.includedMac: This macOS version shares all sound, the voice chat included: viewers will hear their own voices. On macOS 14.2 and later, Balacopapo's own audio is left out. macOS asks for Screen & System Audio Recording permission.
systemAudioNote.includedLinux: Linux shares all sound, the voice chat included: viewers will hear their own voices. Needs PulseAudio, or PipeWire with pipewire-pulse.
systemAudioNote.unavailableMac: System audio needs macOS 13 or later.
